title: VCFArrow
text: package six main functionalities: (1) reading writing VCF data files, including precalculation diverse metrics used filtering functions; (2) data filtering functions; (3) merging VCFs; (4) subsetting VCFs; (5) generation summary statistics graphs; (6) data transformation writing data formats (population genetic phylogenetic formats) downstream analyses. designed fast, implementing shared, C++ backed APIs functions, parallelized possible, memory efficient, implementing lazy-loaded Apache Arrow data scheme. package , therefore, capable processing VCFs comprising tens millions SNVs hundreds individuals matter seconds minutes minimal RAM overhead.

text: Filtering consists removing samples variants based specific properties. function vcf_filter_missing() function filters samples based % missing SNV threshold. functions filter properties individual SNVs across samples. function vcf_filter_missingness() removes SNVs % missing threshold, vcf_filter_quality() removes SNVs quality threshold, vcf_filter_pass() removes SNVs PASS filters, vcf_filter_maf() removes SNVs minor allele frequency % threshold, vcf_filter_hets() removes SNVs heterozygosity % threshold, vcf_filter_rank() removes SNPs rank % threshold (rank specific VCFs generated DiscoSnpRad measures likelihood observed SNP variation due paralogs), vcf_filter_rpt() removes SNPs repeat score threshold (repeat also specific DiscoSnpRad VCFs; high values indicate paralogs), vcf_filter_paralogs() applies rank repeat filter, vcf_filter_adr() either removes (make genotype missing) corrects (make genotype homozygous) genotypes allele ratio imbalance, vcf_filter_coverage() sets genotypes read depth (DP) threshold missing (default strict = TRUE), strict = FALSE leaves genotypes unchanged removes SNVs fewer two polymorphic genotypes threshold, vcf_filter_biallelic() removes variants biallelic. title: Fast and Memory-Efficient Manipulation and Conversion of VCF Files
text: VCFArrow stores genotypes disk chunks variants, functions process one chunk time. vcf_set_workers() starts number background R processes (workers) distributes chunks , several chunks processed time. applies read_vcf(), genotype-based filters, sample group extraction, vcf_stats() vcf_theta(), assess functions, vcf_bind(), write_vcf(), vcf2*() exporters vcf2gt_long() CSV output. Functions use variant table (example quality, PASS, biallelic indel filters) fast always run main session. workers started reused every following call vcf_set_workers(1) called R session ends. Results depend number workers. worker separate R process holds 1 GB memory, memory use grows number workers. Workers pay large datasets: 18.6 million variants 56 samples, functions ran twice fast 4 workers, workers brought little gain reading writing disk becomes limit. small datasets one tutorial, starting workers costs time save, code run .
code: # process chunks on 4 background R processes vcf_set_workers(workers = 4)  # ... read, filter, compute statistics and export as usual ...  # stop the workers and return to processing in the main session vcf_set_workers(1)

text: First need read VCF. one information grouping individuals, information can also put VCFArrow object. grouping information stored ‘strata’ file (text file header line least two columns, ‘id’ ‘pop’, separated tabs spaces; tabs, names may contain spaces). Samples listed file get group (NA), warning. grouping individuals can used filtering steps, necessary transformation VCFArrow object population genetic formats, many require . data used example (Mota et al., 2026)—population genomic analysis Phyllomedusa vaillantii species complex. original dataset 18579683 SNVs 56 samples. purpose tutorial, dataset randomly subsampled 10000 SNVs 18 samples (five samples three main lineages Phyllomedusa vaillantii ingroups, plus three samples Phyllomedusa bicolor included outgroups). Samples can renamed rename_vcf_samples(), named vector (c(old = "new")), data frame file columns ‘id’ (current name) ‘new_id’ (new name). default sample keeps group; update_groups = TRUE groups taken ‘pop’ column. text: function converts VCFArrow object external MIGRATE-N formatted file. Writing occurs chunks whose size determined read_vcf() function. Larger chunks result faster writing speeds. groups defined, default behavior use groups. data file follows Migrate-N manual (section 4, "Data file specification", https://peterbeerli.com/downloads/migrate/docs/migratedoc.pdf). Method "S" writes sequence data: sample two haplotypes (_1, _2) SNPs' nucleotides ('?' missing), cut loci block_size consecutive SNPs, labelled "(sK)" (sequence locus K sites). Method "N" writes sequences cut loci SNPs one CHROM within interval block_size bp, labelled "(nK)" (K linked SNPs), data type N (SNPs) first line. Method "C" writes allele counts population Migrate-N's HapMap format (data type H): SNP position, REF ALT nucleotides counts, total; manual describes format preliminary.  SNPs without called alleles population left (warning), Migrate-N compute allele frequencies . first line gives number populations loci.  Individual names written fixed field 10 characters, Migrate-N's default; longer names needed, warning gives nmlength set parmfile.  Population names must start number. Whether loci SNPs treated linked depends whether SNPs mapped (linkage known) called de novo.

title: vcf_filter_adr — vcf_filter_adr
text: function either changes heterozygous genotypes makes missing VCFArrow object /threshold normalized ADR ratio, returning new VCFArrow object. ADR calculated ADR = ALT / (REF + ALT), AD field. called heterozygous genotypes affected; homozygous missing genotypes left unchanged, even AD gives ADR. 'correct' mode, heterozygote ADR < threshold becomes REF homozygous, one 1 - ADR < threshold becomes ALT homozygous. 'remove' mode, heterozygotes become missing. number genotypes corrected removed reported. default remove loci may become invariant result change/removal genotypes.

text: function removes loci RANK threshold REPEAT threshold VCFArrow object, returning new VCFArrow object. applies vcf_filter_rank() vcf_filter_rpt(). RANK REPEAT metrics focus different paralog signals, used jointly maximize true positive minimize false positive detections. Simulations indicate removing loci Rk < 0.2 RPT > 0.5 gives best results, Rk < 0.4 RPT > 0.5 slightly conservative.

title: vcf_stats — vcf_stats
text: function calculates average read depth, heterozygosity number heterozygotes, number reference alternative homozygotes, missing data total number SNPs sample VCFArrow object. average read depth mean DP sample's called genotypes. Optionally calls vcf_theta() get total group Watterson's theta pi. inbreeding coefficient F sample method--moments estimate vcftools –het plink –het, F = (O - E) / (N - E). uses biallelic SNVs sample called, least two samples reference set called reference set polymorphic (N sites; monomorphic sites change F); O number homozygous genotypes sample sites, E expected number, sum 1 - n / (n - 1) * 2p(1 - p) sites, p ALT allele frequency n number called alleles reference set. f_ref = "" reference set samples; f_ref = "group" sample's group, avoids excess homozygosity differences allele frequency groups cause pooled (Wahlund effect). F NA samples without sites (e.g. group one sample f_ref = "group", sample without group). table gives F N, O E (F_sites, F_hom_obs, F_hom_exp), sample mean F group (F_group_mean; group's samples F). CSV file one row per sample, sorted group sample, columns: sample; read_depth (mean DP called genotypes); heterozygosity (heterozygotes / called genotypes); heterozygotes; homozygotes, homozygotes_ref homozygotes_alt; missing_p (proportion missing genotypes), missing_n non_missing; total_loci; F F_group_mean; F_sites, F_hom_obs F_hom_exp (N, O E ).  theta = TRUE followed theta_total pi_total (Watterson's theta pi samples) theta_w pi (sample's group). follow group , theta = TRUE, n_ind (number samples group).

title: VCFArrow 0.10.0
text: New function vcf2fstructure(), alias vcf2structure() writes fastSTRUCTURE format default (method = "F"). New function rename_vcf_samples() renames samples, named vector (c(old = "new")), data frame file columns id new_id; default sample keeps group, update_groups = TRUE takes groups pop column. genotype files rewritten, sample names stored every genotype. vcf_filter_adr() now changes called heterozygotes: "correct" mode imbalanced heterozygote becomes homozygote majority allele, "remove" mode becomes missing. Previously genotype ADR outside threshold affected, "correct" filled missing genotypes allele depths (AD), "remove" set homozygotes missing. also reports number genotypes corrected removed. vcf_stats() (read_depth) assess_vcf_coverage() use read depth (DP) called genotypes . DP sometimes written missing genotypes lowered mean depth samples much missing data added low depths coverage plot. vcf_sub_SNVs_stratified() now returns exactly n_SNVs SNVs. CHROM contributes proportional share rounded , remaining SNVs come CHROMs largest remainders. Previously share rounded , CHROMs variants contributed none: DiscoSnp-RAD data, nearly every variant CHROM, SNVs returned. Subsamples drawn given seed differ earlier versions. vcf_filter_coverage() gains strict (default TRUE): called genotypes DP threshold, without DP, set missing, vcftools --minDP , number reported; variants removed, follow e.g. vcf_filter_invariant() vcf_filter_missingness(). strict = FALSE gives previous behavior: genotypes changed, variants least two called genotypes DP >= threshold, polymorphic among , kept. vcf_filter_oneSNV() gains by_quality (default FALSE): TRUE keeps SNV highest QUAL block instead first. SNVs without QUAL rank last ties go first SNV, VCFs without QUAL (DiscoSnp-RAD output) give default result, warning. vcf2plink_bed() (vcf2admixture()) vcf2plink_ped() allele_code = "12" now write ALT allele 1 REF allele 2, PLINK converts VCF (plink --vcf): ALT column 5 .bim file coded 1 .ped file. PLINK’s A1 counts frequencies therefore refer ALT. Previously allele 1 REF. assess_vcf_coverage(): violin now ends sample’s lowest highest plotted depth (trim = TRUE) instead extending beyond . vcf_suggest_chunk_size() now computes memory genotype row columns, including samples’ FORMAT text (new argument fmt_chars) sample names (sample_chars), shares memory workers (workers). previously assumed 20 bytes per genotype, quarter real size, suggested chunks four times large. n_columns deprecated ignored. vcf_memory_estimate(): default chunk_size now 50,000, read_vcf() (100,000). vcf_filter_invariant() vcf_filter_coverage() (strict = FALSE) new argument strict_poly sets counts polymorphic. strict_poly = FALSE (default) variant polymorphic counted alleles , e.g. REF ALT occur. strict_poly = TRUE polymorphic counted genotypes , previous behavior, also removes variants every sample heterozygous. functions remove invariant variants changing samples genotypes (vcf_filter_missing(), vcf_extract_samples(), vcf_extract_groups(), vcf_filter_adr()) take argument, also default FALSE, default now keep -heterozygous variants. show() (printing VCFArrow object) now reports numbers biallelic SNVs, multiallelic variants indels, samples per group, number chunk files, percentage missing genotypes number phased genotypes first chunk file holds current variants. previously always reported “Phased genotypes: FALSE”, filtering FORMAT preview showed first variants source VCF instead object’s . Arrow schema longer printed. samples strata file get group NA warning, samples still assigned; previously single missing sample left every group NA; id assigned one group, missing id pop column, missing file now stops clear error; previously duplicated id misnamed column silently gave @groups wrong length; file read tab-separated header line tab (fields may contain spaces empty), otherwise space-separated, columns read text, numeric ids keep leading zeros. vcf_filter_missing() vcf_filter_missingness() report final percentage missing genotypes retained variants samples (verbose = TRUE), documentation described; vcf_extract_samples() vcf_extract_groups(). sample filters reads genotypes , verbose = FALSE avoids. GT found name FORMAT, alleles read, including alleles several digits (0/11, 10/2); previously first three characters sample field taken genotype, haploid calls lines without GT gave alleles taken next field (e.g. 1:5:... read 1/5) 10/2 1/-1; haploid genotypes stored homozygous (1 1/1); genotypes one missing allele (./1) two alleles, unreadable ones, stored missing, warning reports many , together lines without GT fewer sample columns samples; ADR computed biallelic sites , vcf_filter_adr() longer changes genotypes multiallelic sites, first two AD values need genotype’s alleles; DP, GQ AD values notations (e.g. 1e2) read correctly, negative values treated missing; chunk_size must positive whole number. INFO fields AC, , AF NS recomputed samples genotypes written, present (new argument update_info = TRUE), stay correct samples genotypes removed changed; variants without valid position written (warning) instead written position -2147483648; warns variants sorted position (e.g. vcf_bind(mode = "union")); compresses default out_file ends .gz; adds ##source=VCFArrow line header. POS stored double, positions beyond 2,147,483,647 (chromosomes longer 2.1 Gb) kept instead becoming NA. adds 4 bytes per variant variant tables. vcf2genlight() stores positions NA (genlight positions integers), warning. vcf2eigenstrat() writes positions .snp file without scientific notation (e.g. 0.00004100, 4.1e-05). vcf_bind() (mode = "union" outgroup = TRUE, absent_as = "missing"): genotypes absent source object written write_vcf() ./. instead .. vcf2bayescan(): line starts locus number, BayeScan requires (missing, shifting every column); vcf2bayesass(): writes BA3’s native format, one line per individual locus (indivID popID locID allele1 allele2, alleles 1 = REF, 2 = ALT, missing 0 0), warns BA3’s limits; vcf2related(): line starts sample name, missing genotypes 0 0 (NA); vcf2apparent(): line starts sample name, missing genotypes -/- (?/?); vcf2fineradstructure(): writes one line per RAD locus, defined vcf_filter_multiSNV() (new argument block_size), sample’s two haplotypes locus’s SNVs RADpainter’s syntax (TGAT/CGAT, TGAT , empty missing), genotypes taken phased; wrote one line per SNV allele pairs ,C NA,NA; vcf2eigenstrat(): .geno digits count copies reference allele (REF, column 5 .snp), EIGENSTRAT defines ; counted ALT copies; vcf2eigenstrat(): new argument chrom_code; default non-numeric CHROM (e.g. contig names) numbered 1, 2, 3, … .snp file, EIGENSOFT needs integer chromosomes, mapping written <out_file>.chrommap, warning gives numchrom set 22 codes; first line gives number loci (blocks), SNVs, method "N" starts data type N (SNPs); loci labelled (sK) method "S" (nK) method "N" throughout (method "S" labelled last block (nK), method "N" blocks (sK)), method "N" block lengths follow order sequences (listed sorted CHROM order); individual names written fixed field 10 characters, warning giving nmlength set longer names (followed tab, Migrate-N read part name); population names starting number error; method "C" writes allele counts Migrate-N’s HapMap format (data type H: position, REF ALT counts, total); previous format one Migrate-N documents; method "C" leaves SNPs without called alleles population (warning): Migrate-N crashes ; vcf2genepop(): population starts Pop alone line, GENEPOP documents (adegenet::read.genepop() failed pop WA); new argument pop_names = TRUE writes pop <group> ; vcf2smartsnp(): genotype file header line, smartsnp requires (smart_pca() failed ); samples groups, column order, written <out_file without extension>_samples.smartsnp smartsnp’s sample_group; vcf2plink_ped(): new argument allele_code; "12" writes alleles 1 (REF) 2 (ALT), .ped coding ADMIXTURE reads; vcf2treemix(): compresses file gzip, TreeMix expects, out_file ends .gz (new argument gzip); vcf2structure(): documentation describes file layout notes fastStructure adds .str --input name; locus names (GENEPOP, BA3, EIGENSTRAT, Migrate-N, genlight) CHROM_POS wherever ID missing, empty .; previously every ID missing, VCF . IDs gave . loci; vcf2snapp() declares data DATATYPE=INTEGERDATA SYMBOLS="012" instead DATATYPE=DNA: BEAST 2 reads DNA data nucleotides, whose alphabet 0, 1 2.
